# Sources correction review

Reviewed commit: d588fa96e0db384b29812bbab9dfa5d69ab78b1e; baseline: bb56af2180a660124b7278bb9e947d11264a5adb.
`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/sources.py --check` exited 0: 2 repositories, 523 artifacts; no native or semantic verification.
Recommendation: accept at d588fa96e0db384b29812bbab9dfa5d69ab78b1e for the focused sources correction. This does not establish benchmark readiness or measured tool quality.

## Standards
No naming, duplication, abstraction or scattered-change defect identified in the inspected sources diff. Changes outside the sources files were not reviewed; no candidate files were modified.

## Spec
The prior conflict finding is resolved: [sources.json:9556](../benchmark/sources.json#L9556) preserves XML text content `zyah_solutions_lib_interface_for_actor_ini >=1.0.1.2`, identity `zyah_solutions_lib_interface_for_actor_ini`, constraint `>=1.0.1.2`, explicit `conflict` relationship and source path. These match pinned `$LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT/actor-framework/Providers/Actor Framework Project Providers 2024 for 2020.vipb:20` (XML spells the operator `>=`). Impact: structured lookup now identifies the conflicting package correctly; no further correction required.
The implementation at [sources.py:172](../benchmark/scripts/sources.py#L172) and documentation at [sources.md:37](../benchmark/sources.md#L37) agree with the inspected record; other declarations receive `requires` at [sources.py:193](../benchmark/scripts/sources.py#L193).
Bounded Python comparison against bb56af2 found actor-framework unchanged at 261 declared entries / 357 declarations, now 356 requirements and one conflict; pylavi remains 0 / 0. After removing added relationship fields, only the corrected conflict entry differs. Dependency method/unknown fields and all manifest content outside dependencies are unchanged. No unexpected dependency changes found; no correction required.
Prior evidence: [review #134](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/134#issuecomment-6617406422) passed the six sampled declarations, cross-project provenance, licenses, pins and original hashes, with revise requested only for this conflict. Those passing checks were not repeated.
Unchecked: exhaustive dependency completeness, binary linkage, package-member resolution, installed modules, native loading, runtime compatibility, diagram accessibility and independent save-version decoding. Semicolon-separated and absent-constraint cases were inspected in code, not exercised against additional fixtures.
The [sources requirements](../docs/perpetua/evaluation.md#L63) remain preparation requirements: other versions/families, independent answers, split isolation, matched baselines and method challenges remain missing or unreviewed; quality is unmeasured ([sources.md:49](../benchmark/sources.md#L49), [sources.md:57](../benchmark/sources.md#L57)).

## What next
Policymaker should use this commit-bound recommendation for the sources milestone and retain the explicit coverage gaps. Resume from this report and #134; avoid repeating its passing checks or interpreting manifest verification as semantic validation. No candidate fixes or additional focused review work remain.

No changes to merge.
